content.text: {"spec_patch":{"sense":{"what":["air temperature inside the fridge","relative humidity inside the fridge"],"interval_s":300},"environment":{"location":"inside a household refrigerator compartment","flags":["needs-airflow","temp:-15..70C"]},"connect":{"transport":"wifi","experience":["phone notification when readings go out of range"]},"power":{"source":"unknown"},"experience":{"alerts":["temperature above the safe fridge range","humidity above the chosen limit"],"dashboard":true},"capabilities":["read.temperature_c","read.humidity_pct","net.wifi"],"assumptions":["Readings are taken about every 5 minutes","Wi-Fi is used so alerts reach your phone","History is kept so you can see trends over time"],"open_questions":[{"field":"power.source","question":"Should it run on a rechargeable battery inside the fridge, or can a USB cable reach it?"}]},"candidate_questions":[{"field":"power.source","question":"Would you like it to run on a rechargeable battery sitting inside the fridge, or can you run a USB cable to it?"},{"field":"power.target_life_days","question":"If it's on battery, how long should it last between charges?"}],"assumptions":["Readings are taken about every 5 minutes","Wi-Fi is used so alerts reach your phone","History is kept so you can see trends over time"],"reply":"Got it — a small sensor that sits in the fridge, checks temperature and humidity every few minutes, and pings your phone over Wi-Fi if either drifts out of range, with a history view so you can spot patterns.
